channel.title: Clovermoor Printables
channel.description: Ideas and how-tos for printables and digital design files.

item.title: New Year's Eve Games Sorted by the Hour to Play Them
item.description: New Year's Eve games for families and adults, sorted by when to play them: arrival games, one-minute challenges after 10 p.m., and games that end at midnight.

item.title: New Year Resolution Ideas You Can Measure and Keep
item.description: New Year resolution ideas by life area, each written as a goal you can measure, plus what a study of 1,066 people found about wording resolutions that last.

item.title: New Year's Eve Party Ideas: Themes, Food and a Plan
item.description: New Year's Eve party ideas sorted by crowd and prep: easy themes, food that lasts to midnight, an hour-by-hour plan from 7 p.m. and an early midnight for kids.

item.title: How to Play Dreidel: Rules, Letters and House Rules
item.description: How to play dreidel: everyone antes one piece, spins in turn, and nun means nothing, gimel take all, hei take half, shin put one in. Plus fixes for long games.

item.title: Christmas Gift Tag Ideas, Plus What to Write on Them
item.description: Christmas gift tag ideas you can make tonight: paper, clay, felt and dried orange tags, a colour code for big families, and short wording for every recipient.

item.title: Christmas Bulletin Board Ideas That Use Student Work
item.description: Christmas bulletin board ideas for classrooms and hallways: student-made trees, lights, stockings and gingerbread boards, titles to copy, and fire code limits.

item.title: How to Make Paper Snowflakes With Six Points
item.description: How to make paper snowflakes: cut a square, fold it into a triangle, fold in half, then in thirds, trim the top and cut shapes into both folded edges.

item.title: Christmas Would You Rather Questions for Every Crowd
item.description: Christmas would you rather questions for kids, adults, families and work, plus four ways to play and a simple test for writing questions that start a debate.

item.title: Christmas Pictionary: Words, Rules and Game Setup
item.description: Christmas Pictionary words from easy to hard, song and film titles, and the drawing rules from the official game sheet that settle arguments on the night.

item.title: Christmas Family Feud Questions With Answers
item.description: 37 Christmas Family Feud questions with ranked answers for family, kids and office, plus home rules and a way to score them by surveying your own guests.

item.title: Letter to Santa: What to Write and Where to Mail It
item.description: How to write a letter to Santa, with sample letters by age, plus the 2026 Santa addresses and deadlines for the US (Dec 5), Canada (Dec 9) and the UK (Dec 9).

item.title: Christmas Scavenger Hunt: Clues, Lists and Setup
item.description: A Christmas scavenger hunt is a clue trail or a list of items to find. Here are 20 rhyming clues with answers, indoor and outdoor lists, and a setup plan.

item.title: How to Draw a Christmas Tree: 4 Easy Ways
item.description: How to draw a Christmas tree: a triangle and a trunk, layered branches, then a star and decorations. Four methods, from stacked triangles to a real fir.

item.title: Christmas Drawing Ideas: 40 Easy to Harder Subjects
item.description: Christmas drawing ideas from easy (candy cane, bauble, snowman) to harder (sleigh, village, wreath), a 24-day December drawing calendar, and ways to use them.

item.title: Christmas Riddles With Answers, Easy to Hard
item.description: 40 Christmas riddles with answers, sorted easy, medium and hard, plus carol and film title riddles, how to run a riddle game and how to write your own.

item.title: Christmas Card Ideas: 30 DIY Designs That Post Well
item.description: Christmas card ideas to make at home: paper trees, washi tape, fingerprint lights, pop-ups. Plus card and envelope sizes, and which designs cost extra to mail.

item.title: Gingerbread House Ideas: 30 Designs by Build Type
item.description: Gingerbread house ideas sorted by how you build: kit, from scratch, graham crackers or paper. Themes, candy roofs and walls, and the drying time for each step.

item.title: Christmas Bingo: Rules, Word List and Card Sizes
item.description: How to play Christmas bingo: cards of 3x3 to 5x5 pictures or words, a caller, and five in a row to win. Includes a 60-word call list and the card math.

item.title: Christmas Party Ideas by Crowd, Space and Prep
item.description: Christmas party ideas sorted by who's coming: themes, food and games for family, adults and work, with a four-week plan and the two-hour rule for buffets.

item.title: Christmas Charades: 90 Prompts by Difficulty
item.description: Christmas charades ideas sorted easy, medium and hard, with the classic hand signals, simple rules, scoring and a skip rule so no actor gets stuck.

item.title: White Elephant Rules: How to Play and Steal
item.description: White elephant rules: each player brings a wrapped gift, draws a number, then opens a new gift or steals an opened one. Gifts freeze after two or three steals.

item.title: Secret Santa Questionnaire: Questions That Help
item.description: A Secret Santa questionnaire asks 8 to 12 short questions: what they'd love, what to avoid, allergies, a favourite snack and a gift card they'd use.

item.title: Christmas Trivia Questions With Checked Answers
item.description: 52 Christmas trivia questions with answers in five rounds: carols, films, Santa, traditions and food. Every answer checked against a reference page.

item.title: Christmas Card Messages and What to Write
item.description: What to write in a Christmas card: a greeting, one personal line, a wish for the new year and your name. 52 messages for family, friends, work and hard years.

item.title: Pixels to cm: Chart and Converter for 72 to 300 DPI
item.description: 100 pixels are 2.65 cm at 96 dpi and 0.85 cm at 300 dpi. A chart of pixels in cm at 72, 96, 150 and 300 dpi, plus a converter that works both ways.

item.title: Elf on the Shelf Ideas: Easy, Funny and No-Mess Setups
item.description: Elf on the Shelf ideas sorted by night-time effort: quick setups, funny scenes, arrival and goodbye ideas, and a table of prep, cleanup and touch risk.

item.title: Advent Calendar Ideas: What to Put In for 24 Days
item.description: Advent calendar ideas: small treats, notes, printables and activities, with quick ones on busy weeknights and bigger ones on the three December weekends.

item.title: Preschool Activities by Skill, Matched to Milestones
item.description: Preschool activities for ages 3 to 5 by skill: fine motor, early literacy, numbers, movement and art, matched to CDC milestones, plus small-parts safety.

item.title: Bridal Shower Games: How to Play the Classics
item.description: How to play the classic bridal shower games: bridal bingo, he said she said, how well do you know the bride, toilet paper dress, advice cards. Plan two to five.

item.title: Wall Decor Ideas for Every Room, With Hanging Heights
item.description: Wall decor ideas: art prints, gallery walls, mirrors, shelves, plates, maps and textiles, plus how high to hang them (centre at 57 in) and strip weight limits.
